fusions.name: Slab Bash
fusions.desc: Rams the target with a slab of reef, dealing 14 damage and stunning it for 1.2 seconds, and leaves it 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Skimmed Slate
fusions.desc: Skims a flat fragment up to 6 tiles that deals 5 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach, and leaves the target [Hindered] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Barnacled Face
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 30% and your physical resistance by 10% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Fouling Guard
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying a condition, your armour rises by 12%.
